intro: Taiga Wisemane in Shadowprey Village says the Burning Blade holds a Demon Box, and that something powerful called the Hand of Iruxos is kept inside. At Mannoroc Coven, the Burning Blade makes use of it to open demon portals. Taiga sends you to Thunder Axe Fortress to fetch the box.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Burning Blade possesses the Demon Box. Within it lies the powerful Hand of Iruxos. The Burning Blade uses it to open demonic portals at Mannoroc Coven. We must stop the tide of demons entering our world, friend!
Use this demon pick on the red crystal in Thunder Axe Fortress to gain access to the Demon Box.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, do you have the Demon Box?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, the Demon Box. Give it to me, adventurer, and I shall open... And thus reveal to you the Hand of Iruxos.
